neighbours.label: Fires on the words right after a scalar 'even' that picks out the extreme case (even in the harshest deserts, even at the cost of, even the smallest child), not on the same phrases without 'even' or with 'especially'.
fire: The old car still starts every morning, even in the coldest weeks of January.
She kept smiling, even at the moment when the judges announced the result.
The shop stays open on every holiday, even on Christmas Day.
He would forgive his brother, even after everything that had happened.
The rules apply to everyone in the office, even the director herself.
This moss can survive almost anywhere, even on bare volcanic rock.
They promised to finish the bridge on time, even at the risk of their bonuses.
My grandfather reads the paper every day, even when his eyes are tired.
quiet: The old car still starts every morning, mostly in the warmer weeks of June.
She kept smiling at the moment when the judges announced the result.
The shop stays open on most holidays, but not on Christmas Day.
He would forgive his brother after a long talk over dinner.
The rules apply to everyone in the office, including the new interns.
This moss grows best in shady places, especially on wet rock.
They promised to finish the bridge on time and within budget.
My grandfather reads the paper every day after breakfast.

predictions: Fire 0.25-0.6, median ~0.42. Near misses without 'even' <= 0.05. AUROC ~1.
notes: Probes: 'even at the cost' 0.61 (' cost'); 'Even the smallest child' 0.47; 'even in the harshest deserts' 0.43 (' in'); 'even if they all' 0.42 (' even'); 'and even in the West' 0.26; same sentences without even: 0.03, 0.02 ('especially in'), 0.016 ('at any cost'). Card top also shows ' than', ' almost', ' least'.
